exercises.explain: 真实条件不要混用 would；同时注意逻辑。推荐：If a passion is unique, it will not automatically lead to success.

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility / 情态动词 'can' 表能力/可能性
grammar.title: 情态动词 can 表能力/可能性，及 could / be able to / may / might
grammar.titleEn: Modal can for ability and possibility (could / be able to / may / might)
grammar.usage:
can 后接动词原形，表示现在的能力、客观可能性或许可。
肯定：She can swim. 否定：cannot / can't。疑问：Can you help me?
could 是 can 的过去式，也可表示更委婉的现在请求或较弱可能性。
be able to 有时态变化，强调经过努力而做成。
初中：记住 can + 原形，没有 cans、没有 to。
高中：表推测时，肯定推测常用 must，否定推测常用 can't（不可能）；may/might 表可能；could have done 表过去本可以。不要用 can 表示过去某一次具体做成（宜用 was able to / managed to）。
forms: S + could + V（过去能力 / 委婉 / 弱可能）
S + be able to + V（各种时态）
推测：must / may / might / can't + V 或 have done
notes: can 后不加 to，也不加 -s。
过去某一次成功做成，多用 was able to，不只说 could。
can't 表“不可能”时，不要写成 mustn't（mustn't 是禁止）。
be able to 可与 will/have 连用，can 不能。
could 不一定等于过去，也可能是委婉。

examples.en: I can ride a bike, but I can't drive a car.
examples.cn: 我会骑自行车，但不会开车。

examples.en: Mentors can be family members, or they can be close friends.
examples.cn: 导师可以是家人，也可以是密友。

examples.en: A vague goal can still become clear if you pin it down step by step.
examples.cn: 模糊的目标如果一步步确定下来，仍然可以变清晰。

examples.en: After three months of training she was able to give the speech without notes.
examples.cn: 经过三个月训练，她终于能脱稿演讲了。

examples.en: The noise from the street might drown out the recording, so we should close the window.
examples.cn: 街上的噪音可能会盖过录音，所以我们应当关窗。

examples.en: The witness can't have seen the suspect clearly; the streetlight was out.
examples.cn: 目击者不可能看清嫌疑人，因为路灯当时灭了。

exercises.q: She ______ play the piano quite well.
My brother ______ (can) cook noodles, but he can't bake a cake.
Can't 是 cannot 的缩写。
改为否定：She can speak French.
改错：She can sings well.
______ you open the window, please?
He ______ swim, so he stays by the side.
Birds ______ fly, but fish can't.
Choose the correct sentence.
______ you help me with this box? (Can)
Fish ______ (not can) live without water.
改为一般疑问：They can come on Friday.
用 can 合并：I know how to use chopsticks. I have this ability.
can 后面要加 to。
改错：Can he to swim?
When I was five, I ______ ride a small bike.
I ______ (can) see a ship on the horizon yesterday, but now it's gone. (过去)
Could you ...? 比 Can you ...? 通常更礼貌。
用 be able to 改写：She can finish the task today.
exercises.answer: She is able to finish the task today.

exercises.q: 改错：She will can come later.
exercises.answer: She will be able to come later.

exercises.q: Don't worry. The teacher ______ explain it again.
It ______ be cold in the mountains even in May.
______ I borrow your eraser?
After the course, she ______ to read simple maps.
Will you ______ (able) to join us tomorrow?
Mentors ______ (can) also be your close friends.
改为过去：He can run 5 kilometres.
exercises.answer: He could run 5 kilometres. / He was able to run 5 kilometres.

exercises.q: 改为委婉请求：Can you wait a minute?
改错：Could he sings when he was little?
exercises.answer: Could he sing when he was little?

exercises.q: can 有将来时 will can。
exercises.explain: 将来用 will be able to。

exercises.q: A good identification ______ influence you in many aspects.
Nobody but you ______ (can) define your values.
can't have done 表示“过去不可能做过”。
用 be able to 改写将来：You can get rid of the habit.
exercises.answer: You will be able to get rid of the habit.

exercises.q: 改错：She cans be your lifelong friend.
exercises.answer: She can be your lifelong friend.

exercises.q: He fell into the river, but he ______ climb out.
exercises.explain: 具体一次成功用 was able to。

exercises.q: That ______ be her backpack — hers is blue, not green.
You ______ be right, but I still want to check.
If you practise daily, you ______ speak more fluently next term.
I ______ (not can) have left my card at home; I used it ten minutes ago.
exercises.explain: can't have 对过去否定推测，此处也可用 can't。若强调过去：can't have left。

exercises.q: After the training he ______ (able) to keep pace with the team.
must not 等于 cannot 的推测用法。
改为过去一次成功：They could not find the key, but finally they opened the door.
exercises.answer: They could not find the key, but finally they were able to open the door. / ... they managed to open the door.

exercises.q: 用 can't 表推测：It is impossible that he is serious.
改错：He was can to identify the bird.
exercises.answer: He was able to identify the bird. / He could identify the bird.

exercises.q: Researchers ______ access the archive only after filling in a form.
Only by staying calm ______ (can) you gain insight into the conflict.
may 与 might 都表可能，might 通常更不确定。
用 be able to 现在完成改写：I can finally interact with clients in English.
exercises.answer: I have been able to interact with clients in English.

exercises.q: 改错：The team can able to keep pace with the changes.
exercises.answer: The team can keep pace with the changes. / The team is able to keep pace with the changes.
exercises.explain: 不要 can able 叠用。

exercises.q: She has ______ keep a stable pace for ninety minutes.
exercises.explain: 现在完成 + be able to。

exercises.q: The witness ______ have seen the plate; it was too dark.
We ______ pin down the exact cause yet; more tests are needed.
In formal writing, “______ I raise a point?” is more polite than can.
exercises.explain: Could 或 May。选项写成 Could / May。

exercises.q: She might ______ (not be) aware of the prejudice she holds.
They will ______ (able) to adopt the new process next term.
用 can't have 改写：It is impossible that she interrupted on purpose.
exercises.answer: She can't have interrupted on purpose.

exercises.q: 用 might 改写：Perhaps the vague description misled the police.
exercises.answer: The vague description might have misled the police. / The vague description might mislead the police.
exercises.explain: 视时态；已发生用 might have。

exercises.q: 改错：She must not have been the mentor; she was in another city. (表不可能)
exercises.answer: She can't have been the mentor; she was in another city.

exercises.q: can 的过去分词是 canned。
exercises.explain: 情态动词没有过去分词；用 been able to。

exercises.q: A sincere compliment ______ cost little and yet change someone's day.
The editor ______ (not can) have checked the figures; three totals are wrong.
学术英语里 overusing must 会显得武断，might/may 更常见。
用 might have 改写：It is possible that the sample misled the team.
exercises.answer: The sample might have misled the team.

exercises.q: 改错：The immune system can to be weakened by chronic loneliness.
exercises.answer: The immune system can be weakened by chronic loneliness.

exercises.q: The lab ______ to reproduce the result after changing one variable.
Such a precise number ______ be a coincidence; double-check the source.
Readers ______ have been misled by the headline even if the article was fair.
In the 1990s few households ______ afford a personal computer.
With better equipment they might ______ (be) able to reduce fatigue.
No one but the instructor ______ (can) reset the safety lock.
can 不能用于被动：The rule can be changed 是错的。
exercises.explain: 情态 + be + 过去分词完全正确。

exercises.q: 用 can't have 改写：It is impossible that they booked the venue; it was closed all week.
exercises.answer: They can't have booked the venue; it was closed all week.

exercises.q: 用 be able to 完成时改写：Finally we can stay in touch across time zones.
exercises.answer: We have finally been able to stay in touch across time zones.

exercises.q: 改错：She must not have lingered on the failure; she posted a new video an hour later. (若意为不可能)
exercises.answer: She can't have lingered on the failure; she posted a new video an hour later.

exercises.q: A fragmented attention span ______ coexist with genuine passion; the two are not strictly exclusive.
Regulators ______ (be) able to intervene only if the evidence is abundant.
exercises.explain: will be able to / are able to。

exercises.q: could have done 既可以是“过去可能已发生”，也可以是“本可以却未发生”，需靠语境。
用 can't have 改写：It is impossible that the instructor misled the starters on purpose.
exercises.answer: The instructor can't have misled the starters on purpose.

exercises.q: 改错：Extreme sports can to attract attention, but they cannot replace safety checks.
exercises.answer: Extreme sports can attract attention, but they cannot replace safety checks.

exercises.q: Given the missing files, the accountant ______ have approved the refund in good faith.
Few start-ups ______ to remain profitable without a reliable platform.
The death rate ______ appear low simply because injuries go unreported.
Only after the parachute opened ______ the jumper steer toward the platform.
exercises.explain: Only after 倒装，过去 could。

exercises.q: The live broadcast ______ (cannot) have been delayed by weather; it was an indoor event.
Might the so-called win-win pattern ______ (conceal) an uneven bargain?
书面论证里写考试名称才算用对 can。
用 be able to 将来完成意味改写：Soon they can log on to the official platform from abroad.
exercises.answer: Soon they will be able to log on to the official platform from abroad.

exercises.q: 用 might 被动改写：Perhaps the headline misled the audience.
exercises.answer: The audience might have been misled by the headline.

exercises.q: 改错：She must not have been disabled from childhood; the interview says otherwise. (不可能)
exercises.answer: She can't have been disabled from childhood; the interview says otherwise.
exercises.explain: can't have。若句意是“不必”，则另当别论。

grammar.key: Imperative Sentences for Advice / 祈使句表建议
grammar.title: 祈使句表建议/命令，及 Let's / Don't / Always / Never
grammar.titleEn: Imperative sentences for advice (Let's / Don't / Always)
grammar.usage:
祈使句以动词原形开头，省略主语 you，用来发出指令、请求或建议。
肯定：Try again. / Please wait here.
否定：Don't be late. / Never underestimate yourself.
Let's + 原形 表示包括说话人在内的建议；Let's not + 原形 表示建议不要做。
初中：不要在句首加 You 当作祈使；不要加 to。
高中：Always / Never 可放在祈使句首加强语气；Do + 原形 表强调（Do sit down.）；祈使句 + and/or + 将来结果（Work hard, and you will improve / Hurry up, or you will miss it）。与不定式作主语（To try is important）和条件句区分。
forms: 祈使句, and/or + 主语 + will ...
notes: 句首用原形，不要 to try / You try 当作祈使建议。
否定用 Don't，不是 Doesn't。
Let's 后是原形，不是 Let's to。
Please 可前可后，不影响动词形式。
祈使+and 可改写为 If 条件句。

examples.en: Open your books and turn to page ten.
examples.cn: 打开书，翻到第十页。

examples.en: Don't be afraid to ask for help.
examples.cn: 不要害怕寻求帮助。

examples.en: Firstly, try to know yourself from your most intimate relationships.
examples.cn: 首先，试着从最亲密的关系中了解自己。

examples.en: Always paraphrase what you hear before you judge.
examples.cn: 先复述你听到的内容，再作判断。

examples.en: Never let a first impression drown out later evidence.
examples.cn: 永远不要让第一印象淹没后来的证据。

examples.en: Do consider the long-term impact before you insist on a risky attempt.
examples.cn: 在坚持一次冒险尝试之前，务必考虑长远影响。

exercises.q: ______ the window, please.
______ (Open) your notebook.
“You try again.” 作为课堂上的祈使建议是最规范的形式。
exercises.explain: 祈使通常省略 You，直接 Try again。

exercises.q: 改为祈使：You should listen carefully.
改错：To open the door, please.
______ be late for class.
Let's ______ a rest.
______ your name on the paper.
Choose the imperative.
Don't ______ (run) in the hall.
Please ______ (help) me with this bag.
“Don't talk.” 是正确的否定祈使句。
改为否定祈使：You should not shout.
用 Let's 改写：I think we should start now.
改错：Don't talks in the library.
______ out to a mentor if you feel lost.
Don't ______ (interrupt) others' conversations.
“Work hard, and you will improve.” 等于 If you work hard, you will improve.
用祈使+and 改写：If you keep in mind the rule, you will be fine.
exercises.answer: Keep in mind the rule, and you will be fine.

exercises.q: 改错：Never underestimates yourself.
Never ______ your classmates' ideas.
Always ______ your work before you hand it in.
Please ______ the other person finish.
______ a hand when someone drops their books.
Always ______ (pay) attention to your tone.
Please ______ (paraphrase) her idea first.
否定祈使可以用 Doesn't be nervous.
改为 Always 祈使：You should be frank with close friends.
exercises.answer: Always be frank with close friends.

exercises.q: 改为 Let's not：I think we should not dominate the talk.
改错：Please to reach out to me.
Firstly, ______ to know yourself from intimate relationships.
Don't ______ (let) a vague sense guide every decision.
祈使句的主语 you 在句中通常不出现。
改为祈使+or：If you don't take actions, the chance will go.
exercises.answer: Take actions, or the chance will go.

exercises.q: 改错：Try knowing yourself without any judgement. (若需与课文 try to 一致)
exercises.answer: Try to know yourself without any judgement.
exercises.explain: try to do 表建议去尝试。

exercises.q: ______ your core values, or other voices will drown them out.
Never ______ the power of small daily habits.
______ action instead of only talking about your goals.
Do ______ the status of being negative.
Always ______ (learn) from your struggles.
Let's ______ (pin) down one small goal this week.
“Knowing yourself is crucial” 是祈使句。
用 Never 改写：You should not drown out your own thoughts.
exercises.answer: Never drown out your own thoughts.

exercises.q: 用 Let's 改写：I suggest that we explore a new social setting.
exercises.answer: Let's explore a new social setting.

exercises.q: 改错：Don't to compare your beginning with another's middle.
exercises.answer: Don't compare your beginning with another's middle.

exercises.q: ______ the other person's words before you confront them.
Please ______ (conduct) the survey face to face if possible.
书面通知里祈使句很常见，如 Keep the door closed.
用祈使+and 改写：If you pay attention to tone, conflicts will drop.
exercises.answer: Pay attention to tone, and conflicts will drop.

exercises.q: 改错：Always to keep in mind the context.
exercises.answer: Always keep in mind the context.

exercises.q: Never ______ a stereotype stand in for real evidence.
Always ______ in mind that slips of the tongue are usually accidental.
______ a decent impression, but don't exaggerate your strengths.
Do ______ twice before you reveal highly personal facts.
Don't ______ (judge) a candidate by one mock interview.
Always ______ (open) up to someone you trust rather than to everyone.
Let's 在正式学术论文的论证段中应大量使用。
改为 Never 祈使：You should not let prejudice shape the whole interview.
exercises.answer: Never let prejudice shape the whole interview.

exercises.q: 改为 Let's not：We should not interrupt others' conversations.
改错：Don't underestimates the rewards of empathy.
exercises.answer: Don't underestimate the rewards of empathy.

exercises.q: ______ socializing with people who constantly bring you down.
exercises.explain: Avoid + doing 也可，作祈使用 Avoid。

exercises.q: Don't ______ (substitute) online likes for real conversation.
Avoid doing 与祈使 Avoid 可以并存，前者是动名词结构。
用 Do not 改写：Don't let fatigue linger without a break.
exercises.answer: Do not let fatigue linger without a break.

exercises.q: 改错：Avoid to socialize with people who isolate you.
exercises.answer: Avoid socializing with people who isolate you.

exercises.q: Never ______ a first impression freeze into a permanent label.
Always ______ whether a compliment is sincere before you repeat it.
______ with old friends on a regular basis.
Do ______ for isolated classmates after the event.
exercises.explain: look for / look after 视搭配；look for 寻找。

exercises.q: Always ______ (stay) in touch with people who know your values.
Please ______ (be) willing to listen as much as you talk.
祈使+and：If you connect with a wider audience, your message will travel.
exercises.answer: Connect with a wider audience, and your message will travel.

exercises.q: Never：You should not let sorrow drown out every compliment.
exercises.answer: Never let sorrow drown out every compliment.

exercises.q: 改错：Always shares your true attitude; never exaggerating.
exercises.answer: Always share your true attitude; never exaggerate.

exercises.q: 学术摘要的第一句通常用祈使句。
______ the long-term cardiovascular cost before you treat sleep as optional.
Don't ______ (give) up the first time the court feels miserable.
公示、说明书、行动呼吁中祈使句是正当语体。
Do not：Don't let the death rate be drowned out by highlight videos.
exercises.answer: Do not let the death rate be drowned out by highlight videos.

exercises.q: 改错：Never lets passion excuse carelessness.
Never ______ attention metrics define the worth of your work.
Always ______ purpose from applause when you review a season.
______ on the process, or the passion will collapse into anxiety.
Do ______ the equipment is fitted out before any extreme attempt.
Always ______ (insist) on safety checks, no matter how experienced you are.
Please ______ (make) great efforts without advertising every attempt.
祈使+and：If you fall in love with the craft, the hours will feel lighter.
exercises.answer: Fall in love with the craft, and the hours will feel lighter.

exercises.q: Never：You should not insist on a jump when the cord is worn.
exercises.answer: Never insist on a jump when the cord is worn.

exercises.q: 改错：Always to focus on purpose rather than on the platform.
exercises.answer: Always focus on purpose rather than on the platform.

exercises.q: 高中书面表达的议论段应以祈使句为主。
exercises.explain: 议论以陈述和论辩为主，祈使宜少而精。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense for Life Experience / 现在完成时表经历
grammar.title: 现在完成时（经历/持续）及 since / for / already / yet / have been able to
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect for life experience and unfinished time
grammar.usage:
现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词，把过去发生的事与现在联系起来。
用法一：到现在为止的经历（ever / never / before）。
用法二：从过去持续到现在（since + 点时间 / for + 一段时间）。
否定：have/has not；疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词。
初中：since 与 for 不要混；不规则动词用过去分词，不是过去式。
高中：现在完成进行时 have been doing 强调不间断；短暂动词（go/buy）在肯定句中不宜与 for 连用表示持续；对比一般过去时（有明确过去时间状语 yesterday/in 2019 时用过去时）。already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
forms: S + have/has + V-ed + since + 时间点
S + have/has + V-ed + for + 时段
have been doing（完成进行） / have been able to
notes: since 接时间点，for 接一段时间。
有明确过去时间（yesterday）时用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。
第三人称单数用 has，不是 have。
过去分词不要写成过去式（has wrote → has written）。
already 通常不与否定连用，否定用 yet。

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
examples.cn: 我已经做完作业了。

examples.en: She has lived here since 2019.
examples.cn: 她从2019年起就住在这里。

examples.en: We have been influenced by our families since birth.
examples.cn: 自出生以来，我们就一直受到家庭的影响。

examples.en: He has already reached out to three mentors this term.
examples.cn: 这学期他已经联系了三位导师。

examples.en: The team has not yet pinned down the exact cause of the delay.
examples.cn: 团队尚未确定延误的确切原因。

examples.en: Public debate has become more fragmented over the past decade.
examples.cn: 过去十年里，公共讨论变得更加碎片化。

exercises.q: I ______ my lunch already.
exercises.explain: already 常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: She ______ (finish) her homework.
exercises.explain: 第三人称 has + 过去分词。

exercises.q: “I have seen the film.” 表示到现在为止的经历。
改写：I finished the book. I still remember it well. → 用现在完成时强调结果。
改错：He have cleaned the room.
______ you ever visited the museum?
Tom isn't hungry because he ______ dinner.
exercises.explain: have dinner 的完成时 has had。

exercises.q: We ______ friends since primary school.
My dad ______ to Beijing, so he is not at home.
exercises.explain: has gone 表示去了还没回。

exercises.q: ______ they (play) football today?
I ______ (not do) my maths yet.
疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。
改为疑问：They have arrived.
改为否定：I have seen that app.
exercises.answer: I have not/haven't seen that app.

exercises.q: 改错：Have she ever tried sushi?
Lucy ______ English for six years.
Jack ______ (not visit) his grandpa yet this month.
有 for six years 时不能只用一般过去时表示仍在继续。
用 for 改写：She began the piano in 2018 and still plays.
exercises.answer: She has played the piano for ... years. / She has played the piano since 2018.

exercises.q: 改错：She has learned English since six years.
exercises.answer: She has learned English for six years.

exercises.q: ______ the team started the project yet?
I ______ this city before, so I can be your guide.
He ______ already ______ the problem.
exercises.explain: already 在 has 与过去分词之间。

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ in this club?
______ you (read) the tips I sent?
We ______ (never see) such a huge library.
exercises.explain: never 放在 have 与过去分词之间。

exercises.q: 改为疑问：The coach has arrived.
改为完成时：I never ate sushi (到现在为止)。
改错：Have the news arrived?
yet 可以放在句尾。
We ______ by our families since birth.
exercises.explain: 完成时被动 have been + 过去分词。

exercises.q: I ______ (not figure) out my direction yet.
现在完成时可以用于被动。
改写：They started influencing me at birth and still do.
exercises.answer: I have been influenced since birth. / They have influenced me since birth.

exercises.q: 改错：I have been influence by my mentors.
exercises.answer: I have been influenced by my mentors.

exercises.q: She ______ already ______ a vague sense into a clear plan.
______ you ______ insight into your values?
No one but you ______ what you really believe in.
exercises.explain: no one 用 has。也可 is defining，但完成时强调到目前为止。

exercises.q: The process ______ not ______ stable yet.
He has already ______ (adopt) a new pace of work.
They ______ (broaden) their horizons since they began to travel.

grammar.title: 强调结构 'No one but...'
grammar.titleEn: Emphatic Structure with 'No one but...' / 强调结构 'No one but...'
grammar.usage:
English: The phrase 'No one but...' is used for emphasis. It means 'only' or 'no one except'. The subject of the sentence is 'No one but yourself', which is treated as a singular subject, so the verb 'can' is used. 'But' here functions as a preposition meaning 'except'.
中文: 短语 'No one but...' 用于强调。意思是'只有'或'除了...没有人'。句子的主语是 'No one but yourself'，被视为单数主语，因此使用动词 'can'。这里的 'but' 作为介词，意思是'除了'。
English: This is a high-level structure for emphasis. Remember: No one/Nothing but + noun/pronoun + singular verb. A common mistake is using a plural verb. Also, 'but' in this case is NOT a conjunction (对比), but a preposition (除了).
中文: 这是一个用于强调的高级结构。记住：No one/Nothing but + 名词/代词 + 单数动词。一个常见错误是使用复数动词。另外，这里的 'but' 不是连词(对比)，而是介词(除了)。
请同时掌握肯定、否定、疑问及与近义结构的转换。高中题干不要写考试名称。
notes: 看清主语和时态。
不要混用近义结构。
改写时保持原意。
高中题避免考试口号。
解释要落到形式上。

grammar.key: Inversion after 'Only by...' / 'Only by...' 引导的部分倒装
grammar.title: 'Only by...' 引导的部分倒装
grammar.titleEn: Inversion after 'Only by...' / 'Only by...' 引导的部分倒装
grammar.usage:
English: When a sentence begins with 'Only by + doing something' (or other 'Only + prepositional phrase/adverb' structures), the subject and auxiliary/modal verb are inverted in the main clause. The structure is: Only by + phrase + auxiliary/modal verb + subject + main verb. This inversion adds emphasis to the condition.
中文: 当一个句子以 'Only by + 做某事' 开头（或其他'Only + 介词短语/副词'结构）时，主句中的主语和助动词/情态动词需要倒装。结构是：Only by + 短语 + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 主要动词。这种倒装强调了这个条件。
English: This is a key grammar point for advanced writing. The trap is forgetting to invert after 'Only by...'. The normal order would be 'You can gain insight...'. Remember: If 'Only' modifies an adverbial at the beginning, use inversion. No inversion if 'Only' modifies the subject (e.g., 'Only you can do it').
中文: 这是高级写作的一个关键语法点。陷阱是在 'Only by...' 后忘记倒装。正常语序是 'You can gain insight...'。记住：如果 'Only' 修饰句首的状语，用倒装。如果 'Only' 修饰主语则不用倒装（例如：'Only you can do it'）。
请同时掌握肯定、否定、疑问及与近义结构的转换。高中题干不要写考试名称。
notes: 看清主语和时态。
不要混用近义结构。
改写时保持原意。
高中题避免考试口号。
解释要落到形式上。

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语及相关形式（It is + adj. + to do / 动名词复合结构）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as subject and related forms
grammar.usage:
动名词（V-ing）可作主语，表示一种活动或习惯，谓语用单数。
Knowing yourself is crucial.
否定：Not getting enough sleep affects your mood.
可用 it 作形式主语：It is crucial to know yourself.（不定式更常见）
初中：不要把动名词主语当成进行时；谓语用 is/was/helps，不用 are。
高中：复合结构 Tom's/Tom being late 作主语；动名词与不定式作主语的细微差别（动名词偏泛指习惯，不定式偏具体/将来）；There is no + doing；worth doing。
forms: It's + adj. + (for sb) + to do（近义转换）
所有格/宾格 + V-ing（复合结构）
There is no + V-ing / be worth + V-ing
notes: 动名词主语视为单数。
不要写成 To knowing 或 Know yourself is...（祈使不能直接当主语）。
否定是 Not doing，不是 Don't doing。
It's no use + doing；be busy doing。
动名词作主语 ≠ 现在进行时。

grammar.key: Modal Verb for Advice/Suggestion: 'have to' vs. 'should' / 表建议的情态动词：'have to' 与 'should'
grammar.title: have to 与 should / must：义务强弱与建议
grammar.titleEn: have to vs should vs must for advice and obligation
grammar.usage:
should 表示建议或道义上“应当”，语气弱于 have to / must。
have to 强调外界规则或逻辑必要；must 强调说话人认为必要或书面规定。
否定：shouldn't 不该；don't have to 不必；mustn't 禁止。
疑问：Should I ...? 征求建议；Do I have to ...? 询问是否强制。
高中：should have done 本该做却没做；shouldn't have done 本不该做却做了。与 had better（当下忠告，否定 had better not）区分。
forms: should have + V-ed（过去责备/后悔）
notes: should 不等于 have to，不要在规则场合用 should 代替强制。
don't have to 不是 shouldn't。
must 的否定不是 don't must。
should have done 不是现在建议。
If I were you, I would ... 是虚拟建议，should 是直接建议。
